title: GateWatch: Low-Overhead LLM Monitoring with Boolean Circuits
abstract: arXiv:2611.24619v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) and LLM-based agents are increasingly deployed, monitoring their behavior becomes important for detecting unsafe or unintended actions. Activation probes offer an efficient approach, but existing methods face trade-offs between accuracy, interpretability, and computational overhead. Probes on raw activations lack interpretable inputs, whereas sparse autoencoder (SAE) probes use interpretable features but often rely on additive classifiers and large SAE encoders, limiting interpretability and increasing memory overhead. We introduce GateWatch, a compact, interpretable classifier that expresses its entire decision rule as an explicit Boolean logic over a small number of binarized SAE features. We explore three approaches to constructing these circuits under a specified gate budget. translated_title: GateWatch：基于布尔电路的低开销大语言模型监控
translated_abstract: 随着大语言模型（LLM）和基于LLM的智能体日益广泛地被部署，监控其行为对于检测不安全或非预期的动作变得至关重要。激活探针提供了一种高效的方法，但现有方法在准确性、可解释性和计算开销之间存在权衡。基于原始激活值的探针缺乏可解释的输入，而稀疏自编码器（SAE）探针虽然使用可解释的特征，但通常依赖于加性分类器和大型SAE编码器，这限制了可解释性并增加了内存开销。我们提出了GateWatch，这是一种紧凑且可解释的分类器，它将整个决策规则表达为对少量二值化SAE特征的显式布尔逻辑。我们探索了在给定门预算约束下构建这些电路的三种方法。为了高效部署，GateWatchServe仅计算选定的SAE特征，并支持将其二进制值跨层流式传输（原文摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: GateWatch通过将决策规则表达为少量二值化SAE特征上的显式布尔逻辑电路，实现了紧凑、可解释且低开销的大语言模型行为监控。
en_tdlr: GateWatch achieves compact, interpretable, and low-overhead LLM monitoring by expressing its entire decision rule as explicit Boolean logic circuits over a small number of binarized SAE features.
